Mewtwo

Psychic

Kanto · Generation 1 · Legendary Pokémon

Mewtwo is a Psychic-type Genetic Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 2 m tall and weighs 122 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (154), with a base stat total of 680.
